summary: Two independent R3 reviews and a separate protocol graph audit agree that v24/v20 retain the strengthened Pin, Linux FD/OFD and post-S5 foundations, but official admission remains architecture-blocked by deployable cross-identity actor launch and lease handoff, frozen P2 execution/path provenance, runtime self-binding, 6/44 ledger snapshot authority, durable invocation/result evidence, immutable-slot HARD_HOLD behavior, and cancellation/finalization semantics.

limitations: The consolidated result only records independent read-only findings and does not change the reviewed design.

No product/test/contract/gate/ledger/status/historical-evidence implementation changed; no project-code execution, training, archival replay, budget consumption, PIT certification, M7 or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: Freeze a trusted outer-dispatcher launch graph for distinct P0 supervisor, P1 verifier and archive-acceptor identities, including READY handshake, descriptor allow-list, separate OFD lease acquisition and S5 handoff/crash behavior.
Replace the same-process raw call with P0-to-P1-to-P2 execution: P2 must receive no P0 IPC/control FD, run a fixed isolated interpreter/import root, and terminate with its P1 parent.
Define a verified child-visible staging path/namespace that the unchanged Path.resolve worker can traverse without gaining control-root access, and prove staged qlib_peerlite import provenance.

Bind the actual inner runtime to Pin/Policy RuntimeClosure and AuthorizedEntrypoint refs before Bootstrap/PASS/E/C, and bind the exact M6 6/44 authority prefix through observed live snapshot bytes into staged ledger bytes.
Give StagedMechanicsInvocationV1 and NormalizedMechanicsResultV1 durable no-replace slots or explicitly frozen inline bytes so archive recovery can independently re-open them after job quarantine.

Define absent/exact/malformed immutable decision-slot handling as publish/idempotent/HARD_HOLD, resolver PENDING versus REJECTED outcomes, and policy-bound P1/P2 deadlines, cancel/kill/reap/finalization order.

Reissue architecture and change design, then obtain fresh independent R3 design-review PASS before test design, red tests, implementation, code review, replay, M7, CCC/Gate, PIT certification or final-OOS work.
